transcript:
(a) A development that helped the civil rights movement grow was when the Supreme Court ruled segregation in schools was unconstitutional in Brown v. Board of Education in 1954. This gave the movement a legal foundation.

(b) The civil rights movement changed society by passing big laws like the Civil Rights Act of 1964 which banned segregation, and this happened because the movement pressured Congress with marches and protests.

(c) The government responded by doing things to help. It enforced desegregation.
